messages:
anita: bringing up needle-skein-v1 embeddings — quick sanity checks: int6 vs fp16 on shortquery holdout. dropping r@1 slightly, sharing quick numbers.
ben: which dataset and index?
anita: wiki+cc shortquery holdout (10k queries), gallery 1M, HNSW efSearch=128, efConstruction=200
chris: paste results
anita:
```
model                       quant        r@1    r@5    r@10
needle-skein-v1             fp16         0.712  0.880  0.912
needle-skein-v1             int6         0.694  0.866  0.900
needle-skein-v1             int6-perch   0.701  0.872  0.905
``` 
zara: r@1 delta ~ -0.018 vs fp16 — not huge but consistent :eyes:
ben: what's batch size & normalization?
anita: batch=64, micro=8, normalized (L2), cosine sim
chris: any seed variance? run multiple seeds
anita: ran 3 seeds: r@1 = [0.694, 0.697, 0.691] for int6
zara: clustering/umap?
anita: UMAP 2D attached (desc): int6 clusters slightly smeared; mean centroid cos shift ~0.028
chris: could be quantization bias on layernorm weights. try per-channel calibration and range clipping
anita: plan: 1) run per-channel int6 with 2k calibr samples 2) try fp16->int8 hybrid 3) run recall@1 stratified by query length
eval-bot: regression-alert: recall@1 -0.018 (p<0.05) against baseline needle-skein-v1 fp16
ben: ok let's run the sweep. I'll run per-channel cal and microbatch sweep
anita: command to repro:
```
python eval.py --model needle-skein-v1 --quant int6 --calib 2000 --batch 64 --index hnsw --ef 128
```
zara: add logging for per-layer activation means
chris: also check norm saturation plots
anita: will kick off full sweep now, will post results in this thread :thumbsup:
